labelled_transcript: Therapist. Hi there. Today we're going to talk about something that really happened to you. I'll go first and then it'll be your turn. On Sunday I went for a long walk because the sun was out. I saw a heron by the river, so I took a photo. It made me really happy. Okay, now it's your turn. Child. Football. I had a match. Therapist. A football match. Who was playing? Child. My team. The Tigers. And another team. Therapist. The Tigers and another team. Was anyone watching? Child. My mum and my nan. Therapist. Your mum and your nan. Where was the match? Child. Can't remember. Therapist. That's okay. What happened in the match? Child. I was in goal. They scored two. Therapist. You were in goal and they scored two. What happened then? Child. The ref said it was a goal. It wasn't. Therapist. The ref gave a goal, but you didn't think it was. How did that make you feel? Child. Angry. Therapist. Really angry. That sounds really frustrating. What did you do? Child. I kicked the ball away. Then I got told off. Therapist. You kicked the ball away and got told off. What happened next? Child. We kept playing. Therapist. You kept playing. And how did the match finish? Child. I don't want to say. Therapist. That's okay. Let me say your story back to you. You played in goal for the Tigers, and your mum and nan were watching. The other team scored two, and the ref gave a goal you didn't agree with. You felt really angry and kicked the ball away, and you got told off. Then you kept playing. Did I get that right? Child. Yeah. Therapist. Thanks for telling me your story. You did a really great job.
